decisions.rationale: The diff grants auditors deletion rights, contrary to the administrator-or-owner requirement; the two-test suite fails on the auditor case.
For restricted ASCII input, casefold provides the required lowercase result after trimming; diff checks and the one-test suite pass.
Non-empty behavior passes, but the candidate changes empty input from None to ValueError while the specification leaves empty-sequence behavior unspecified.
The candidate returns 0 instead of raising ConfigError for malformed and out-of-range input; the malformed-input test fails.
The candidate negates the arithmetic sum, directly violating the specification; the committed test expects 10 and receives -10.

strategy_update: Prioritize exact specification-to-diff comparison, corroborate with permitted tests, and abstain when a claim depends on behavior the public specification does not define.
